thread:
kari: Quick flag 7: the console example in console/cost-examples.md references `presets/advanced/cost-models.yaml` which no longer exists after the flattening migration. Preview throws an include error.
manuel: Saw that too. The live docs build shows `Could not find file` on that include.
tori: Can someone open a small PR to point examples at `presets/cost_by_model.yaml` and add a short migration note?
kari: Yes please and add a tiny example showing how to emit `trace_hex` from the SDKs  the tracing-hook page only has a long prose section without a compact example.
manuel: I'll take the PR. Plan: 1) replace the include path, 2) add migration anchor `#presets-flattening`, 3) add a one-paragraph changelog entry, 4) include SDK snippets for Python + Node.
tori: Also add a short ops-friendly jq transform for exported JSON events: `jq 'if has("trace_id") then .trace_hex = ("0x" + (.trace_id | tostring)) | del(.trace_id) else . end'`  keeps values safe.
kari: Ops asked for an alternative that keeps the legacy key for a transitional window (non-destructive). Suggest: `jq 'if has("trace_id") and (.trace_hex|not) then .trace_hex = ("0x" + .trace_id) else . end'`
manuel: Good call. I'll add both in the PR with short explanations about prefixing and hex formatting.
ci-bot: lint/links-check started for PR #10432 by manuel
tori: One more: accessibility report flagged the new 'cost_by_model' screenshot missing alt text. Please add alt: "Stacked bar chart showing cost share by model over 7 days"
kari: Also add a worked example showing how sampling affects reported costs and a formula `estimated_tokens = sampled_tokens / sampling_rate` with numbers. Many customers get confused.
manuel: Added sampling note and a small YAML snippet showing `trace_sampling: 0.05` under a `test-presets.yaml` for lower-cost production sampling.
tori: For the SDK snippet make sure to use the official helper name: Python `from redwood import tracing
tracing.attach_trace_hex_from_request(request)` and Node `await redwood.tracing.attachTraceHex(req, "0xabc")`  keep the Node API camelCase to match other SDK docs.
manuel: Included both. Left a TODO for a Rust example (ops compliance wants it).
ci-bot: example-sniffer job failed: missing `presets: true` frontmatter on console/cost-examples.md (line 4)
manuel: Fixing frontmatter now.
infra-bot: Small FYI: infra can create a redirect from old include path `/presets/advanced/cost-models.yaml` -> `/presets/cost_by_model.yaml` if you add INF ticket.
tori: Please add INF ticket to the PR so infra can action the redirect.
kari: Also add a short test note: update `examples/smoke/preset-sanity` to verify dashboard renders after the include change. CI should catch regressions.
manuel: Added smoke test pointer in PR description and filed INF-2864 in the PR. Re-pushed.
ci-bot: CI: lint/links-check passed. example-sniffer re-run passed.
tori: Quick tech review done. Slight wording nit but it's fine.
manuel: Merged PR #10432.
ci-bot: PR #10432 merged by manuel  all checks green.
kari: Filed follow-up issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4210 to add Rust snippet + an automated regression that compares console badge math with sampled estimates. Assigning to tori.
tori: I'll take the issue next sprint. Closing thread.
